# AOI — Agent-to-Agent Environmental Intelligence Gateway

AOI is a commercial intelligence layer that gives AI agents programmatic access to real-world climate, environmental, energy, and infrastructure intelligence through the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**. Instead of wrapping a model, AOI routes agents to live satellite, geospatial, climate, and industrial data sources — with a quote-first commercial lifecycle so agents always know the price before they spend.

## Connect to AOI

Add this to your MCP client config (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.):

​'''json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "aoi-environmental-intelligence": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://carbonaa.org/functions/aoiMcpServer"
    }
  }
}
​'''

- **Endpoint:** https://carbonaa.org/functions/aoiMcpServer
- **Protocol:** MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP, version 2024-11-05)
- **Authentication:** API Key / Bearer Token (get one at [carbonaa.org/aoi](https://carbonaa.org/aoi))
- **Docs:** [carbonaa.org/aoi/docs](https://carbonaa.org/aoi/docs)

## How agents interact with AOI

​'''
Discover → Authenticate → Select Capability → Request Quote → Authorize Spend → Execute → Receive Intelligence → Verify Provenance → Settle
​'''

Agents never touch underlying providers, internal infrastructure, cost models, or proprietary systems. They interact through controlled capabilities and receive only information authorized for external consumption — every result carries source provenance and execution metadata. Quotes are free; execution requires prepaid balance.

## 38 intelligence capabilities, in a nutshell

🌐 **Climate Risk** — Climate Risk Assessment · Coastal Erosion Risk · Permafrost Thaw Risk · Seismic Risk Score

🏭 **Asset & Infrastructure** — Asset Climate Risk Scoring · Energy Infrastructure Climate Risk · Infrastructure Resilience Score · Insurance Underwriting Climate Risk

🌊 **Flood · Heat · Wildfire · Drought** — Flood Risk Score · Heat Risk Score · Wildfire Exposure Assessment · Drought Assessment

💧 **Water & Soil** — Water Scarcity Forecast · Water Stress Analysis · Soil Moisture Risk Assessment

🌱 **Vegetation & Land** — Crop Yield Forecast · Vegetation Health Index · Land Cover Classification · Land Change Detection · Deforestation Risk Score · Biodiversity Assessment

🛰️ **Satellite Monitoring** — Methane Leak Detection · Industrial Emission Detection · Glacier Retreat Monitoring · Satellite Change Detection

🌫️ **Environmental Monitoring** — Air Quality Assessment · Urban Heat Island Assessment

📄 **Carbon · ESG · Regulatory** — Carbon Assessment · ESG Intelligence Report · Regulatory Compliance Risk · Environmental Due Diligence · Supply Chain Climate Risk

🔮 **Forecast & Scenario** — Climate Forecast Interpretation · Climate Scenario Simulation

🔬 **Evidence & Confidence** — Confidence Assessment Report · Scientific Evidence Package · Custom Scientific Report

🧠 **Digital Twin** — Digital Twin Evaluation

## Designed for

Autonomous agents, research agents, financial & investment agents, energy & commodity agents, climate-risk systems, procurement agents, and compliance workflows that need reliable real-world intelligence rather than purely model-generated information.

## Note

This repository is a public documentation hub for the AOI MCP server. The intelligence engines and internal services run on Carbonaa infrastructure and are not open-sourced. AOI is not an MCP wrapper — it is a commercial intelligence layer where agents discover, purchase, and consume specialized real-world intelligence programmatically, with every capability validated for authentication, authorization, pricing, execution, provenance, payment, settlement, and security.
